newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler works council says will lift overtime ban.
newsitem.headline: Daimler works council says will lift overtime ban.

text.p: The works council of Daimler-Benz AG said on Tuesday it was prepared to lift its ban on overtime working at the group following signs of progress in the dispute with employers over sick pay.
Karl Feuerstein, head of the group works council at Germany's biggest company, said employee representatives in Daimler plants should no longer refuse to work overtime.
The extent to which workers did overtime now was a matter for local employee councils.

Daimler's works council had banned overtime working from the start of October after the group spearheaded the implementation of a 20 percent cut in sick pay, made possible by recent government legislation.

Daimler on Monday evening announced it would suspend the sick pay cut after engineering union IG Metall and employers association Gesamtmetall said they would hold talks to try to resolve the dispute.
Thousands of workers last Tuesday staged wildcat strikes and took to the streets in protest at the cuts. Daimler was particularly hard hit by the strikes.
